name: NGC 3348 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 3348, a giant elliptical galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc3348-hubble
story: NGC 3348 is a giant elliptical galaxy at the heart of its group, wrapped in a swarm of globular star clusters. Hubble studied those clusters and found, as in the other giant galaxies of the survey, that they fall into two distinct families.

claims.text: NGC 3348 is one of eight brightest cluster galaxies imaged with ACS; its cluster or group is CfA 69
The targets are giant ellipticals at the centers of their clusters
Globular clusters of NGC 3348 were measured in the study
The globular cluster systems of all eight galaxies show strongly bimodal color distributions
